issue.body: This PR does a few things: * Remove all traces of highlight.js * Use [chroma ](https://github.com/alecthomas/chroma) library to provide fast syntax highlighting directly on the server * Provide syntax highlighting for diffs + code comments * Re-style code view and unified/split diffs views to try and look a bit more 'modern' * Add custom syntax highlighting styling for regular theme and convert previous arc-green highlighting best I could Fixes #7729 Fixes #10157 Fixes #11825 Fixes #7728 Fixes #3872 Fixes #3682 And perhaps gets closer to #9553 Suggestions welcome for styling New Diff:
